audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits WR 49.79 over 703 games: Taliyah bullies pre-6, Diana's 6-spike all-in is lethal, map game decides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[4]/win[5] are off by one against every piece of prose: whys[4], mid, and spikes[1] all say level 6 (row 4) is Diana's, and whys[5]/spikes[2] say first item (row 5) swings back to you — yet win[4]=Taliyah and win[5]=Diana. The full layer already has phases[4].side=Diana, corroborating the swap. Rows 0-3 and 6 in full are blanket Skill/Diana against agreeing content.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: Diana has no dash until 6 (Lunar Rush), so pre-6 rows are Taliyah's; at 6 Lunar Rush + Moonfall + Pale Cascade shield all-ins through poke; first item Taliyah out-shoves and out-roams.
audit.corrected: win[4] Taliyah->Diana and win[5] Diana->Taliyah, full sides aligned, whys rewritten where they disagreed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; the E-mine stun on Lunar Rush (a dash) was never stated as the counter; 12 fields misgendered Diana as he/his.
audit.why: Kit: Crescent Strike 8s rank 1; Lunar Rush 22/20/18/16/14s but FREE against a Moonlit target — the arc dodge removes the reset; Taliyah E explodes and stuns enemies who dash through it, and W knock-through detonates it too. Diana is she/her.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the dash-into-mines interaction written into cooldowns, dos and phases; all pronouns fixed.
